## Stage A — symbolic reduction and identities

Reduction convention [assumed input]: S_6 = ∫√-G [M_6^4 R_6/2 − Λ_6 − F^2/(4 g_6^2)], with F_θφ = n sinθ/2 and round-S² radius R.
Jordan-frame potential before the Weyl division [computed]: U_J(R) = 4πΛ_6 R² − 4πM_6^4 + πn²/(2g_6²R²).
Dividing by R^4 to reach the 4D Einstein frame [computed]: V(R) = 4πΛ_6/R² − 4πM_6^4/R^4 + πn²/(2g_6²R^6).
V(x) = aΛ_6/x − b/x² + cn²/x³ with a = 4*pi, b = 4*pi*M_6**4, c = pi/(2*g_6**2) [computed; assumed input symbols].
Three R powers [computed]: Λ_6 term R^-2, curvature term R^-4, flux term R^-6.

Aethon caveat [standard]: exact flatness requires n₀=√(b²/(4acΛ_6)) to be a whole number; generic Λ_6 gives an AdS/dS boundary rather than an exactly flat integer flux. Exactly flat rows below are tagged [tuned].
Breathing kinetic factor [standard]: K_R = 8M_4²/R² for −K_R(∂R)²/2; at a stationary point d²V/dR²=4xV''(x), so m_radion²=d²V/dR²/K_R=x²V''(x)/(2M_4²) [computed, sign follows V''].
Radion-mass convention [standard]: this code uses the M_4²𝓇 convention, K_R=8M_4²/R² and m²=x²V''/(2M_4²). With the (M_4²/2)𝓇 convention, K_R=4M_4²/R² and m²=x²V''/M_4². The factor of 2 changes the mass normalisation, not its sign or stability.
